parsed.explanation: Thin, mostly non-trans-specific dossier, so I extrapolated from structural signals. No trans-specific criminal, facility, custody or screening rule is documented, and the sexuality statute is secondary. It is not dead letter, though: a domestic CSO documents arrests via false accusations and police torture of LGBTQ people, and the 2012 zero-arrest figure is stale. Security-force impunity is documented, and no custody or detention treatment of trans people is sourced. Legal gender recognition is absent, and visitors' documents are assessed as issued, so any mismatch is a universal-style exposure at checkpoints. Societal discrimination is entrenched and documented in healthcare, employment and education, with no anti-discrimination law and no working recourse. Silence on violence is not safety. Structural signals place this in High Risk, toward the upper part of that band.
